purpose: Selected current-acceptance public originals, not a new acceptance decision or complete historical research/source archive.
zip_entry_rule: Each entry is its unchanged original path relative to OUT. Original receipt paths are not rewritten; relocation-map.json resolves them.
excluded_by_design: Full reviewed source ZIPs and cumulative source diff
Private PostgreSQL credential files and runtime configuration
raw_test_public_basis: Both sealed Review reports explicitly describe retained argv/stdout/stderr without environment or credential contents. Only direct formal outputs, summaries and PG identity/count/schema-cleanup metadata selected; no credential/config/native-input corpus read.
regular_retained_boundaries_location: Regular R7 retained-catch judgement is preserved verbatim in its full report; no separately named retained-boundaries artifact exists in its sealed manifest. Specialized R4 retained-boundaries.json is included.

source_authorities: Root explicit packaging grant: existing public protected merge guard; new byte binding, no state mutation
